This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for July 8, 2026.

Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition.

1. Gaza aid worker killed minutes before World Cup screening he organised. Mohamed al-Wahidi died when a missile struck his taxi shortly before Egypt played Argentina in their last 16 match. This was reported by Al Jazeera and The Guardian.

2. Israeli air strikes in Gaza kill eight, including two children. Medics report 12 injuries alongside eight deaths in Gaza as Israeli air strikes target civilians and displaced families. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

3. Watch: Gaza football fans watch World Cup from rubble. Hundreds of people cheered for Egypt, which shares a border with Gaza, in the match against Argentina. This was reported by BBC News.

4. 'There are risks': Ex-India judge behind damning UN report on Gaza children. Before he exposed. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

5. Timeline: 20 years of Hamas rule in Gaza, from election to political exit. A chronological look at key milestones from Hamas's 2006 election victory to its 2026 exit from governing Gaza. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

6. War on Gaza draws large crowds to Khamenei's funeral in Iraq. More than a million mourners packed streets in Najaf, Iraq for Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei's funeral procession. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

For the full source-backed dispatch, read the July 8, 2026 Gaza edition at dispatches.thebluefernco.com.
